explication: Descheduler is a Kubernetes workload rebalancer: it evaluates already-running pods against a configurable policy and evicts eligible pods; Kubernetes’ default scheduler handles replacements. The main flow is server startup and policy setup, strategy evaluation through framework profiles and plugins, then guarded eviction through the Kubernetes API. The README also documents utilization-based strategies, Prometheus and metrics-provider inputs, and metrics exposure. Several orchestration and integration files were not sampled, so uncertain internal links are omitted or marked unverified.
